description: This file is a stub (interface) definition for the PyTorch C++ profiler module, defining enums, classes, and functions related to profiling and tracing within PyTorch. It provides type annotations and outlines the structure for profiler events, configurations, and metadata.

classes.name: RecordScope
classes.description: Enumeration of different recording scopes within the profiler.

classes.name: ProfilerState
classes.description: Enumeration of various states of the profiler (disabled, active on CPU, CUDA, etc.).

classes.name: ActiveProfilerType
classes.description: Enumeration of active profiler types (none, legacy, Kineto, NVTX, etc.).

classes.name: ProfilerActivity
classes.description: Enumeration of profiling activities (CPU, CUDA, XPU, etc.).

classes.name: _EventType
classes.description: Enumeration of different event types in profiling logs.

classes.name: _ExperimentalConfig
classes.description: Configuration options for experimental profiler features.

classes.name: ProfilerConfig
classes.description: Main configuration class for the profiler, including state and profiling options.

classes.name: _ProfilerEvent
classes.description: Class representing a profiling event with timing and metadata.

classes.name: _TensorMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for tensors involved in profiling events.

classes.name: Scalar
classes.description: Type alias for scalar types involved in profiling.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Type alias for inputs which can be tensors, list of tensors, or scalars.

classes.name: _ExtraFields_TorchOp
classes.description: Additional profiling data specific to Torch operations.

classes.name: _ExtraFields_Backend
classes.description: Additional profiling data for backend operations (empty in stub).

classes.name: _ExtraFields_Allocation
classes.description: Metadata related to memory allocations observed during profiling.

classes.name: _ExtraFields_OutOfMemory
classes.description: Data related to out-of-memory events.

classes.name: _PyFrameState
classes.description: Stack frame information for Python calls.

classes.name: _NNModuleInfo
classes.description: Information about a neural network module.

classes.name: _OptimizerInfo
classes.description: Information about optimizer parameters during profiling.

classes.name: _ExtraFields_PyCCall
classes.description: Metadata for Python C extension calls.

classes.name: _ExtraFields_PyCall
classes.description: Metadata for Python function calls.

classes.name: _ExtraFields_Kineto
classes.description: Kineto-specific profiling data.

classes.name: CapturedTraceback
classes.description: Class representing a captured Python or C++ traceback.

methods.name: _add_execution_trace_observer
methods.description: Start observing execution traces and save to a file.

methods.name: _set_record_concrete_inputs_enabled_val
methods.description: Enable or disable recording of concrete inputs.

methods.name: _set_fwd_bwd_enabled_val
methods.description: Enable or disable recording of forward/backward passes.

methods.name: _set_cuda_sync_enabled_val
methods.description: Enable or disable CUDA synchronization during profiling.

methods.name: gather_traceback
methods.description: Function to gather a traceback from Python and C++ stacks.

methods.name: symbolize_tracebacks
methods.description: Convert raw traceback data into a symbolized, human-readable form.
